name: Concert Grand Piano
author: KryonOS Audio Labs
description: Super-realistic acoustic concert grand piano featuring high-fidelity sound synthesis, 3D ivory & ebony keys, touch glissando, T-Deck QWERTY keyboard mapping, trackball sustain pedal, instrument voice presets, and built-in demo songs.
changelog: Initial release with realistic 3D acoustic concert grand UI, I2S DAC tone synthesis, sustain pedal, demo song playback, and recorder.
